# CBF fixtures

| File | Notes |
| ---- | ----- |
| `sample_minicbf.cbf` | Symlink → `synthetic_minicbf.cbf` (128×128 smoke fixture) |
| `synthetic_minicbf.cbf` | Generated by `tools/make_minicbf_fixture` |

## Smoke test

From `../..`:

```bash
cc -O0 -g -I../../cbf/include -o cbf_smoke cbf_smoke.c ../../cbf/lib/libcbf.a -lm
./cbf_smoke ../testdata/cbf/sample_minicbf.cbf
```

Expect a line starting with `CBF_SMOKE_OK`.

## F77 vs ProcessingLab PROCESS compare

CTest `cbf_process_compare` dual-runs F77 `ipmosflm` and C++ `ProcessPipeline`
on a real Pilatus miniCBF when available:

```bash
export MOSFLM_CBF_IMAGE=/path/to/frame_001.cbf
export MOSFLM_IPMOSFLM=/path/to/ipmosflm   # e.g. ../bin/ipmosflm.oracle
ctest --test-dir build -R cbf_process_compare --output-on-failure
```

Without those, the test soft-skips (exit 0). Default discovery also checks
`mxflask/mxpipe/test_data/KIT-02AT05_w1_1_0001.cbf` and
`../bin/ipmosflm.oracle`.
